name: word-spacing
note: css-text-3 §8: word-spacing adds the given advance to every word-separator character — 10px widens 'aa bb cc' by exactly 20px (two spaces), -2px narrows it, and a 20% percentage resolves against the font size (16px → 3.2px per space, probe-verified). The last word's trailing edge carries no extra advance; atomics and wrap decisions see the widened spaces.
